summary: Sino Green Land Corp. filed an 8-K/A amending its prior 8-K to correct the stock consideration in its Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire all shares of Invent Fortune Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian private company. The corrected consideration is 36,527,833.33 shares of Sino Green common stock, issued in three tranches: 20% at closing, 40% upon a trigger condition (three months post-closing or milestone achievement), and 40% upon additional conditions. The amendment corrects only the share count and tranche amounts; no other terms changed. The acquisition is all-stock, with no stated price per share or implied value. Watch for completion of tranche conditions and potential dilution overhang.
